title: Lemonate
content:
Contribute to the core development of Lemonate’s interactive 3D platform, enabling real-time rendering and deployment of complex
browser-based applications.

title: Blender 3D NFT generator
content: I have been working, during my little spare time, on a Blender's python add-on to generate 3D NFT art procedurally. The add-on gained some popularity inside Blender's forum and there are already multiple users using it, even if it is still in an early development stage and many features are lacking.

title: A study on the crypto market using an Autoregressive Model
content: I fitted an Autoregressive Model (VAR) on a subset of the crypto market. My study focused on cryptocurrencies casual relationships and their casual direction. Furthermore, I was interested in estimating the "big players" that dictate the directions of the market.

title: Image as Mesh
content: A Blender addon to import images as meshes. Inspired by the famous addon: ImagesAsPlanes. The addon will create a 3D object given an image. Results quality depend on the resolution of the image.

title: Lennard-Jones Potential's Molecular Dynamcis Simulation
content: A Molecular Dynamcis simulation using Lennard-Jones potential implemented in python.

title: Image as Mesh
content: Agent model simulation of a prey predatol system.

title: Quadtree image art
content: Approximate images using quadtree i.e. by recursively subdividing the image into four quadrants if some conditions are met. In this case, the split is done whether the image and its mean colour differ in some tolerance. This is not an efficient way of compressing images but the visual result is pleasant to the eye.

title: Schelling's Model of Segregation
content: Python implementation of Schelling's model of segregation: an agent-based particle method. Each agent (in this implementation only two but potentially any number) will try to relocate to an empty cell to satisfy his desire to have neighbourhoods of his kind, if not already satisfied in his current position.

title: 3D Spectral segmentation
content: Implementation of the paper *"Rong Liu and Hao Zhang, "Segmentation of 3D meshes through spectral clustering"* in Blender. In short, it performs the clustering of a mesh vertices depending on the geodesic distance between and concavity between faces. The algorithm, if provided with an appropriate number of clusters, is capable of clustering the important features of a mesh. In the picture the algorithm is applied on Suzanne (the Monkey) with a number of 3 clusters. Note how the two eyes and the body are in separated clusters.

title: Blender Voxelise AddOn
content: A Blender's addon to voxelise 3D objects.

title: Structured light 3D scanner
content: Implementation of *Build Your Own 3D Scanner: Optical Triangulation for Beginners* presented in SIGGRAPH 2009 and SIGGRAPH Asia 2009 Courses (http://mesh.brown.edu/byo3d/).

title: DeepBlend: run neural networks on blender's node system
content: A blender's add-on to allow running neural networks for image generations within Blender's material node system.

title: Geometry Instancing
content: Implementation of geometry instancing using A-Frame, three.js and webGL.

title: Finite Element Method: Poisson Equation
content: Implementation of the finite element method applied on the poisson equation.

title: A WebGL Rendering Engine
content: An implementation of a basic rendering engine using webGL, as an exercise.
